summary: Phase 1: actual prerequisite results before a human selects setup. Preflight does not install, repair, authenticate or verify all application readiness.

purpose.p: Expose missing prerequisites, policy and reachability before individually approved module actions.
A failed or skipped read-only gate stays failed/NOT RUN; no installation is performed to make the check pass.

starting_state.p: Phase 0 approved; supported effective script policy, reviewed root checkout and approved endpoint/network routing.

steps.title: Run the real Preflight task

body.p: Require no FAIL and exit 0 plus the Phase 0 human approvals. Missing WSL/wslc before setup can be an expected WARN; read the actual messages.

steps.expect: Observed read-only prerequisite results, not installed tools, approved extension state or authentication.

steps.title: Understand timeout selection and outer budgets

head: Per-request selection
Six-host outer child budget
Meaning
rows: Normal request setting, not setup completion time
Approved slower route; select it again for setup
Up to about 11 minutes for the outer probe budget

body.p: Transient timeout/DNS/connect errors may retry at most three attempts with 250 ms backoff. Denial/certificate errors do not get those retries; redirects are not followed. Root 404/405 establishes reachability only, not package/source success.
A standalone Preflight selection is not cached. Choose the same reviewed slow value for the following named setup if needed; installer waits are a different budget.

steps.expect: A truthful timeout/reachability result without interpreting a root response as installation permission.

steps.title: Optional pre-setup Verify is inventory, not acceptance

body.p: Before setup, missing expected outputs may yield exit 1. This optional inventory is not the Preflight installation gate. After intended setup, a required FAIL/exit 1 means not accepted.

steps.expect: Missing pre-setup outputs correctly labelled as inventory gaps, never hidden or confused with post-setup success.

expected.p: Approved prerequisites plus observed Preflight outcomes. Continue only to a reviewed human module inventory/confirmation, not a broad automatic setup run.

success.p: Record actual exit code and messages. No FAIL/exit 0 is necessary but does not establish source/profile licensing or a working app.

failures.symptom: HTTPS timeout on a slow approved route
failures.fix: Human may choose documented 15/30-second selection for both Preflight and the following named module. Retain policy and inspect the real result.

failures.cause: Untrusted certificate or imposed network/source policy
failures.fix: Stop and use IT-approved routing; do not disable validation, follow redirects, switch sources or bypass proxy policy.

failures.symptom: Optional Verify reports missing WSL/runtime before setup
failures.fix: Keep the gap explicit and review the necessary named module only after prerequisites and approvals.

recovery.p: Use source/mocks for blocked scripts; preserve all installed state. A retry is read-only only if the command is actually Preflight/Verify, not module preview or configuration testing.

limitations.p: Preflight does not prove vendor installer state, extension enablement/profile routing, package restore, user sign-in, WSL runtime health or Azure approval.

say: Preflight probes prerequisites; it never installs.
Timeout budgets are limits, not completion promises.
A pre-setup inventory gap is not post-setup acceptance.
evidence_gaps: No read-only Preflight or live laptop policy/network acceptance is claimed here.
